skillsSummary: This unit specifies competencies required to perform computer repair and Maintenance. It involves performing troubleshooting, disassembling of faulty components, repairing/replacing faulty components, testing of component functionality upgradation and testing of hardware and  software.

elementsAndPerformanceCriteria.elementTitle: 3. Repair faulty components (disassemble faulty components, repair/replace and reassemble faulty components)

schedule.sessionTitle: Introduction to C.R.M. & User Data Process
learningOutcomes: By the end of the lesson, the trainees should: Explain purpose, scope, and document faulty computer user data.
trainerActivities: Facilitate discussion, demonstrate documentation forms.
traineeActivities: Share experiences, practice filling sample fault logs.
resourcesAndRefs: “Computer Repair and Maintenance ” by John Doe. Chambers, M. (2014). Troubleshoo ting your PC for dummies (7th ed.). John Wiley & Sons. sample forms, projector.
assessments: Oral Qs, review of completed sample logs.

learningOutcomes: By the end of the lesson, the trainees should: Identify troubleshooting approaches.
trainerActivities: Present systematic approaches (e.g., divide & conquer). Use case examples.
traineeActivities: Group discussion on applying approaches to given scenarios.
resourcesAndRefs: OS manuals, case studies, projector.
assessments: Group presentation  on approaches, Q&A.

learningOutcomes: By the end of the lesson, the trainees should: Identify basic computer hardware faults.)
trainerActivities: Demo real faulty components (RAM, HDD, PSU). Explain symptoms.
traineeActivities: Inspect samples, identify and describe faults in groups.
resourcesAndRefs: Sample faulty components, magnifying glasses, symptom charts.
assessments: Group presentation on fault identification, observation checklist.

learningOutcomes: By the end of the lesson, the trainees should: Apply data gathering techniques.
trainerActivities: Explain and demonstrate tools (checklists, interviews, observation).
traineeActivities: Practice using checklists and forms in simulated scenarios.
resourcesAndRefs: User reports, forms, checklists.
assessments: Practical assessment on completing an information-gathering checklist.

learningOutcomes: By the end of the lesson, the trainees should: Analyze user data to identify problems.
trainerActivities: Guide analysis workshop using complex case studies.
traineeActivities: Analyze provided user reports, identify root cause.
resourcesAndRefs: Complex case study reports, whiteboards for group work.
assessments: Submission of group analysis report (portfolio evidence).

learningOutcomes: By the end of the lesson, the trainees should: Determine solutions and apply hypothesis testing.
trainerActivities: Explain hypothesis logic (if-then). Demonstrate testing one variable at a time.
traineeActivities: Develop test plans for given faults, present logical steps.
resourcesAndRefs: Troubleshooting flowcharts, scenario cards.
assessments: Presentation of test plans, peer critique.

learningOutcomes: Apply all LO1 competencies to a simulated user case.
trainerActivities: Brief assessment, provide scenario, supervise.
traineeActivities: Receive scenario, gather data, analyze, propose & test hypothesis, document solution.
resourcesAndRefs: Assessment briefs, isolated workstations.
assessments: Formative Practical Assessment (Observation Checklist, Product Checklist).

learningOutcomes: By the end of the lesson, the trainees should: Select computer components for replacement per factors.
trainerActivities: Explain compatibility, cost, warranty. Use catalogues/datasheets.
traineeActivities: Identify suitable replacements for given faulty components in scenarios.
resourcesAndRefs: Hardware catalogues, spec sheets, compatibility charts.
assessments: Oral quiz on factors, product checklist for selection exercise.

learningOutcomes: By the end of the lesson, the trainees should: Identify and assemble repair tools.
trainerActivities: Demonstrate full toolkit, explain use of each tool.
traineeActivities: Conduct toolkit inventory, practice correct handling.
resourcesAndRefs: Complete repair toolkits, tool identification charts.
assessments: Observation checklist on tool handling, oral test on tool purpose.

learningOutcomes: By the end of the lesson, the trainees should: Observe safety procedures (PPE, equipment, emergency).
trainerActivities: Conduct safety briefing, demo PPE use, fire extinguisher types.
traineeActivities: Participate in safety drill, don/doff PPE, locate safety equipment.
resourcesAndRefs: PPE kits, fire extinguisher (training), first aid kit, safety signage.
assessments: Mandatory Pass/Fail Safety Demonstration.

learningOutcomes: By the end of the lesson, the trainees should: Disassemble computer components safely.
trainerActivities: Live demo of systematic disassembly of a desktop PC.
traineeActivities: Perform supervised disassembly of non-faulty PCs in pairs.
resourcesAndRefs: Desktop PCs, screwdriver sets, anti-static mats/wrist straps.
assessments: Practical checklist on safe disassembly steps.

learningOutcomes: By the end of the lesson, the trainees should: Repair or replace faulty components per manual.
trainerActivities: Demo specific repairs (e.g., RAM reseat, HDD replace, fan swap) using manuals.
traineeActivities: Practice targeted repairs on fault-seeded machines using provided manuals.
resourcesAndRefs: Fault-seeded PCs, component manuals, spare parts.
assessments: Practical assessment: successful repair/replacement of assigned fault.

learningOutcomes: By the end of the lesson, the trainees should: Dispose of faulty/obsolete components per procedures.
trainerActivities: Present e-waste categories, hazards, and local disposal regulations/methods.
traineeActivities: Sort sample components into correct disposal categories.
resourcesAndRefs: Sample obsolete components, e-waste sorting bins, disposal guidelines.
assessments: Oral on disposal methods, observation of sorting activity.

learningOutcomes: Begin full repair cycle project (Troubleshoot & Plan).
trainerActivities: Launch project, brief on multi-fault systems, form groups, guide initial diagnosis.
traineeActivities: Groups receive project PC, perform LO1 steps to diagnose, create repair plan/parts list.
resourcesAndRefs: Project PCs, toolkits, diagnostic software, project logbooks.
assessments: Submission of initial diagnosis and repair plan (portfolio).

learningOutcomes: Execute repair cycle (Repair, Test, Dispose).
trainerActivities: Supervise practical work, ensure safety compliance, mentor.
traineeActivities: Execute repair plan, replace/repair components, test basic functionality, dispose waste.
resourcesAndRefs: Spare parts, tools, safety equipment, e-waste bins.
assessments: Formative Project Assessment (Observation, Third-party report, completed logbook).

learningOutcomes: By the end of the lesson, the trainees should: Perform Power-On Self-Test (POST).
trainerActivities: Demo POST process, interpret common beep codes/on-screen messages.
traineeActivities: Boot lab PCs, observe POST, record results/error messages.
resourcesAndRefs: Functional & fault-seeded PCs, POST code charts.
assessments: Practical observation, completed POST result logs.

learningOutcomes: By the end of the lesson, the trainees should: Perform component tests using techniques/tools.
trainerActivities: Demo diagnostic software (e.g., MemTest86, HDD diagnostics), hardware testers.
traineeActivities: Run diagnostic tests on assigned components, record outputs.
resourcesAndRefs: PCs with diagnostic software, multimeters, PSU testers.
assessments: Product checklist of tests performed, printouts/screenshots of results.

learningOutcomes: By the end of the lesson, the trainees should: Evaluate test results to determine functionality.
trainerActivities: Guide on interpreting diagnostic outputs (pass/fail, thresholds, benchmarks).
traineeActivities: Analyze provided and self-generated test results, make pass/fail judgments.
resourcesAndRefs: Sample diagnostic reports, evaluation rubrics.
assessments: Analysis of a diagnostic report, justifying conclusion.

learningOutcomes: By the end of the lesson, the trainees should: Generate computer component's functionality report.
trainerActivities: Present report template, explain structure (findings, conclusion, recommendation).
traineeActivities: Compose a professional report based on their own or sample test data.
resourcesAndRefs: Report templates, sample reports.
assessments: Submission of a completed functionality report (portfolio evidence).

learningOutcomes: Conduct full testing and reporting on an unknown system.
trainerActivities: Set up assessment stations with PCs having known (to trainer) issues.
traineeActivities: Isolate, test, evaluate, and report on the functionality of key components.
resourcesAndRefs: Assessment stations, all diagnostic tools, report templates.
assessments: Formative Practical Test (Observation + Submitted Report).

learningOutcomes: Integrate testing phase into the LO2 project and review.
trainerActivities: Facilitate session for trainees to test their repaired project PCs and update logs.
traineeActivities: Perform full functionality test on their project PC, update project documentation.
resourcesAndRefs: Project PCs, diagnostic tools.
assessments: Updated project logbook with test results and report.

learningOutcomes: By the end of the lesson, the trainees should: Explain maintenance types and prepare schedules.
trainerActivities: Lecture on preventive/corrective maintenance. Demo schedule templates (weekly, monthly).
traineeActivities: Identify maintenance types from scenarios. Draft a schedule for a lab PC.
resourcesAndRefs: Maintenance plan templates, scenario cards.
assessments: Submission of a drafted maintenance schedule.

learningOutcomes: By the end of the lesson, the trainees should: Perform computer maintenance using utilities.
trainerActivities: Demo software utilities (disk cleanup, defrag, updates) and hardware cleaning.
traineeActivities: Perform guided maintenance on lab PCs (software & physical).
resourcesAndRefs: PCs, cleaning kits, compressed air, maintenance software.
assessments: Observation checklist of maintenance tasks performed.

learningOutcomes: By the end of the lesson, the trainees should: Generate computer maintenance report.
trainerActivities: Show sample reports, explain data to include (tasks done, findings, next schedule).
traineeActivities: Write a report based on the maintenance they performed in session 11.2.
resourcesAndRefs: Maintenance report templates.
assessments: Submission of completed maintenance report.

learningOutcomes: Review all unit competencies and finalize portfolios.
trainerActivities: Facilitate review session, check portfolio completeness, administer final practical and oral tests.
traineeActivities: Compile portfolio, participate in review, sit for final practical and oral tests.
resourcesAndRefs: Portfolio checklist, final theory Practical checklist.
assessments: Final Practical and oral tests, Final Portfolio of Evidence.
